reviews.text: I can’t praise this team enough! They arrived on time, worked with care, and completed the job perfectly. The wallpaper has completely changed the look of my kitchen, giving it a fresh, chic feel. Their attention to detail and dedication to quality are truly commendable. Thank you
reviews.author: Nancy Smith

reviews.text: Quality is the most important thing to me, and these guys did not disappoint me. They handled the wallpapering process like true professionals, making sure every panel was lined up perfectly. The attention to detail was insane! They also finished the job on time and on budget. My room took on a whole new vibe!
reviews.author: Douglas Maynard

reviews.text: Murphy Wallpaper Installer saved our hallway with a fast, flawless fix—better than the original! Polite team, spotless cleanup. Would absolutely hire again.
reviews.author: Bo Payne

reviews.text: The wallpaper you did on my dining room was very good it could hardly have been done better. Everyone on the team was courteous, and accomplished what they had to do quickly and effectively. They managed the difficult design very gently and now the space looks more sophisticated, elegant, and stylish. The overall look of the room is great and I am very happy with the outcome I got with this company, therefore I can recommend them for any wallpapering jobs.
reviews.author: Amy Clark

reviews.text: The wallpaper installation was a breeze! The team paid attention to every detail, and the patterns matched up perfectly. Really happy with the finished look.
reviews.author: Hector Curtis

reviews.text: Wallpaper Dream Designs transformed our bedroom with their expert installation service. From helping us select the perfect wallpaper to ensuring every seam was perfect, they were amazing. The room now feels cozy and luxurious, and I can’t thank them enough. If you’re looking for wallpaper installers who truly care about their work, look no further!
reviews.author: Maibub Saiyyad

reviews.text: I got mine installed last week and, frankly speaking, it transformed the atmosphere of the room entirely. Plain walls to cozy. Thank you!
reviews.author: Aaron Harveyy

reviews.text: This was the first occasion that I was hiring a wallpaper contractor and I am glad I did. They made something really special out of what was a mere space.
reviews.author: Fiona Rose

Christopher Bennett FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is the best way to Install Wallpaper? The best way to install wallpaper is to prepare the walls properly by cleaning and priming them, measure and cut the wallpaper accurately, use the right adhesive, and smooth out bubbles with a wallpaper brush or squeegee. Always follow the manufacturer's instructions. Do I need a professional to hang wallpaper? While DIY wallpapering is possible, hiring a professional ensures a flawless finish, especially with complex patterns or delicate materials. If you're inexperienced, tricky areas like corners and ceilings may be challenging. Will wallpaper damage walls? Wallpaper itself doesn’t damage walls if removed correctly. However, improper removal or low-quality adhesive can peel off paint or drywall. Using a steamer or wallpaper removal solution helps minimize damage. Which type of wallpaper is best? The best type depends on the room: Vinyl is durable and washable (great for kitchens/bathrooms), Fiberglass is breathable and mold-resistant, while Non-woven is easy to install and remove. What is the most expensive type of wallpaper? Handmade or custom-designed wallpapers (like silk, grasscloth, or metallic finishes) are typically the most expensive due to their premium materials and intricate craftsmanship. What type of wallpaper makes a room look bigger? Light-colored wallpapers with small, subtle patterns or vertical stripes create an illusion of space. Glossy finishes also reflect light, making rooms appear larger. What is the most trending wallpaper? Current trends include botanical prints, geometric designs, textured finishes (like faux concrete), and bold murals . Peel-and-stick wallpapers are also popular for renters. Can I wallpaper over painted walls? Yes, but the walls must be clean, smooth, and free of flaking paint. A primer is recommended to ensure proper adhesion, especially for glossy surfaces. How do I fix bubbles after wallpaper is dry? Use a small syringe to inject adhesive under the bubble, then gently press it flat with a roller. For stubborn bubbles, a small pin prick can release trapped air before smoothing. Is wallpaper safe for children's rooms? Most modern wallpapers are non-toxic, but opt for vinyl or washable finishes for easy cleaning. Avoid heavy embossing where kids might pick at the edges. data.summary: The reviews exhibit strong signs of inauthenticity. The perfect 5.0 rating with only 12 reviews, the generic and overly promotional language across all reviews, the lack of any critical feedback, and the absence of a presence on other review platforms are highly suspicious. The content reads like marketing copy rather than authentic customer experiences.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no negative or neutral feedback
Reviews are generic and lack specific project details (e.g., wallpaper type, room dimensions, crew names)
Writing styles are overly similar and promotional in tone
Low total review count (12) for a perfect score
No reviews on other platforms (Yelp, BBB, Angi) where a legitimate contractor would likely appear
Some reviews reference a different business name ('Wallpaper Dream Designs')
authentic_signals: Reviews mention a specific location and service
Some reviews include basic positive sentiments about timeliness and cleanup
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are present, showing a perfect 5.0 rating. No other platforms have ratings or reviews to compare.
